Who I am

Y YAHYA — PORTRAIT.JPG

I am a Graphic Designer focused on clean, modern visual communication. I specialize in logo design, branding, social media visuals, and digital layouts.

My goal is to create simple but powerful visual identities — design that earns its place on the page rather than filling it. Currently open to freelance work, internships, and full-time roles across Europe.
